span.p:
Step-by-step:
1. Entry "F" arrives
2. Cache is full
3. Policy selects "A" (inserted longest ago)
4. "A" is removed even if it was accessed 1 second ago
5. "F" is inserted at the tail

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center; width: 450px;

span.p:
Problem: If "A" is the most frequently accessed entry,
it gets evicted anyway. FIFO does not consider access patterns.

span.p:
Insertion Queue (insertion time order):
Oldest ─────────────────────────── Newest
